svg.title: One DNA sequence, multiple motif preferences
svg.desc: Candidate rank 1; length 2 nucleotides; weakest requirement 0.5. Primary DNA runs 5′→3′; its coordinate-aligned complement runs 3′→5′. Selected windows contain white bases; model information logos color the observed base and leave other bases gray. Information in bits is distinct from motif matching scores. These are model-defined matches, not measured binding.
svg.text: One DNA sequence, multiple motif preferences
Model preferences, not measured binding. Exact scores and positions: inspection JSON.
